notes.title: Kitty's First Update
notes.content:
There, Nyan! This is BOT the developer.
Since the game's release, we've had a lot of player feedback, and we've hurried to fix a few critical bugs (such as missing balloons after save).
We also included cheat codes! Try the following cheat code if you're stuck (press ~ to summon the console).

(Abusing cheat codes will make the game less enjoyable nyan!)

aspirine		Get a free battery
panzer			Get 50 free shells
richmore		Get three balloons
doraemon		Get the ticket and the tram controller
comeflywithme 	Baggy's happy gravity
shanghaied 		Teleport to Archipelago
link		 	Teleport to Snow Mountain Temple
tothemoon 		Teleport to the Rocket (caution)

notes.title: Kitty May Cry is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, our game is now available on Steam and there will be 10% discount in the first week.
As a team of students, it's really a challenge for us to manage this graduation project. But we still made it and we can't wait to see you guys play it.
Thank you so much for constant attention and support! Hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Kitty May Cry will launch on November 14
notes.content: Hello everyone, our game will launch on November 14 and there will be 10% discount in the first week. Kitty May Cry is our graduation work. It's so great to meet a group of friends who love creation and have many common topics in university! After graduation, we also made a series of polishing and improvement, and now we are very excited to finally bring it to you. Thank you so much for constant attention and support！

notes.title: 喵之旅人体验版摄影大赛现已开启！

notes.title: Kitty May Cry Demo is now live!
notes.content:
Nyan, ready for an outing?

You will go on a journey with your companion——Baggy and traverse a mysterious island and its ancient puzzles.

After you leave the mountain hut and climb the hillside, the wide map will unfold to you. In this demo, you can talk to adorable NPCs, collect shells, complete tasks, and freely explore the coastal area in your own way.

Wishlist the game to get latest news!

notes.title: TGS，here we come!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Our game will show up at TGS 2022 official live stream program!
You can watch our latest trailer in TGS official streaming channel at 11:00(GMT+8) on September 15th.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42914160/f829baadd5a1090fae14c232df559c1770414cac.png[/img]
What's more, we are planning to launch the demo version of the game soon. Thanks for your attention and support!
